regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I've been trying to get in touch you for weeks. Am sending you herewith Jim's letter received last Monday. There is since I started this card just a dozen people came in waiting. I wanted to tell you about the jubilee we had out in Royal Oak. There was surely a grand crowd . . about fifty priests -- bishops and sisters. (3 Capuchins)
